derived_from: PPTX XML (ppt/slides/slideN.xml, deck order from ppt/presentation.xml): paragraph text via a:t runs; table cells from a:tbl with paragraphs inside a cell joined by one space, zero-width spaces removed and NBSP turned into a space. Order = slide titles in deck order. In most slides the title shape comes after the body shapes in XML order, so a converter that follows shape order will put the title below the body.
sentences: 1-BP is a volatile chemical with a low global warming potential.
It is used in vapor degreasing, as an industrial solvent in aerospace and defense applications, and in a variety of commercial and consumer products.
The section 6(a) menu of regulatory options can be applied alone or in combination.
EPA is also proposing workplace training requirements in accordance with OSHA’s general PPE requirement standards.
Potentially useful information for comments should include relevant data from the last 20 years.
All comments in order to be considered should be submitted to the docket at EPA-HQ-OPPT-2020-0471
